card.name: Dosage-form word after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug name that names its form, such as capsules, tablets, injection, or sodium. It also fires on a word that continues a compound term, such as intravenous, amino acid, or College Station.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug
modes.description: Form word such as tablets, capsules, or injection following a generic drug name in label text.
modes.example: including prednisone<< tablets>>, suppress the immune system

modes.label: Inside multiword terms
modes.description: A later piece of a multiword or split term, in label or general text.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug name is followed by its form, like tablets or capsules, or where a multiword term continues.
